kebab_example: aliyun iot page-query-shared-speech-open --iot-id Q7uOhVRdZRRlDnTLv000000100 --share-task-code ebed9280_ba25_48df_80c2_0000 --iot-instance-id iot-2w0000 --page-size 10 --product-key sd340000 --page-id 1 --device-name device1 --status 1 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: PageQuerySharedSpeechOpen

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the device that you want to query.

If you specify this parameter, you do not need to specify ProductKey and DeviceName. IotId is a globally unique identifier (GUID) of a device, which corresponds to a combination of ProductKey and DeviceName. If you specify both IotId and the combination of ProductKey and DeviceName, IotId takes precedence
parameters.help_zh:
要查询的设备ID。

如果传入该参数，则无需传入ProductKey和DeviceName。IotId作为设备唯一标识符，和ProductKey与DeviceName组合是一一对应的关系。如果您同时传入IotId和ProductKey与DeviceName组合，则以IotId为准
parameters.name: iot_id

parameters.help_en:
The share code of the speech corpus sharing task.

You can obtain the share code on the Shared Corpus Management page of the Thousand Miles Voice Broadcast Service
parameters.help_zh:
语料分享任务的分享码。

您可在千里传音语音播报服务的分享语料管理页面，获取分享码
parameters.name: share_task_code

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID. You can view the ID of the current instance on the Overview page in the IoT Platform console.

<notice>
If this value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.
If the Overview page or the ID value is not available, you do not need to specify this parameter.

</notice>

For more information about instances, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。您可在物联网平台控制台的实例概览页面，查看当前实例的ID。

<notice>
若有ID值，必须传入该ID值，否则调用会失败。
若无实例概览页面或ID值，则无需传入。

</notice>

实例的更多信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/356505.html
parameters.name: iot_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The number of records to display on each page in the response. Maximum value: 100
parameters.help_zh: 指定返回结果中每页显示的记录数量，最大不超过100
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ProductKey of the product to which the device belongs
parameters.name: product_key

parameters.help_en:
The status of the speech corpus to query. Valid values:

1: Pending review.
2: Approved.
3: Rejected
parameters.help_zh:
要查询语料的状态。可取值：

1：等待审核。
2：审核通过。
3：审核拒绝
parameters.name: status
